text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her sights set on next year's Classic Triple Crown, Rudolf is already training with even greater intensity than before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I understand her reasoning, I'd at least like her to rest during her breaks…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Yes, I see. That should be the last of the equipment inquiries.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Looking over student requests. I asked my vice-president to collate them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ever since we set up an online submission form, we've been receiving more opinions than ever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We will continue to maintain our physical submissions box, of course, but the administration has a responsibility to adapt our methods to the times.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems pleased enough, but spending her break time doing student council work can't be good for her health.
choice_data_list: You should try and get some actual rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Your concern is appreciated, but I'm afraid this is something of a constitutional defect of mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Without a job to do, I get so restless that I make myself more exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Being a workaholic is in my nature. I'd appreciate it if you could take that for what it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's hard to put my foot down when she phrases it like that. As I'm wondering how to respond…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?! I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're the matter. I was under the impression that you were training today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's right. I told you this morning, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed you did. Which is why I specifically messaged you to say that you should look over those requests in the evening.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And yet, for some reason, I got a message that the job was already done. I thought it was strange, so I dropped by the office, and what do I find?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What can I say? I found myself free during my break and thought I might as well start on it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're free during break time because you're supposed to be resting!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your concern, but there's no need to get so worked up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, how am I to introduce you to my trainer as my calm and reliable right hand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, Trainer, allow me to introduce you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is Air Groove, my vice-president.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She is a proud and noble compatriot who pursues a dream very similar to my own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Charmed, I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Air Groove, a racer also known as the Empress, is a big name in Tracen Academy in her own right.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This will be far from the last time you see each other, so you may as well get to know one another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There's one other member of the student council who I had hoped to introduce you to, but… all in good time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's all well and good, President. However, we're not finished speaking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am well aware of your inclination to do everything yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All the same, I would appreciate it if you would at least let me decide which tasks should take priority.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With the volume of requests we're receiving lately, you can't possibly review them all and still have time for your other obligations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But that will do nothing but increase your own workload.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Are you saying that I should offload my responsibilities onto your shoulders?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I… No. Knowing you, you will find a solution on your own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you understand. Now, don't worry about me. Focus on the jobs I have assigned you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Very well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But for today, at least, you must set your duties aside and focus on training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are we agreed?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good. Now, I ought to be going. My apologies for the interruption.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A veritable wunderkind, is she not? I count myself lucky to work alongside someone so capable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And as such, I suppose I must pay heed to her advice. I will focus on training for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Could you add more weights to the barbell, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can still go higher. What's the point in training without pushing myself to the limit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm certainly going to feel that tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But when it comes to weight training, I try to… set the bar high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …That's rather good, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a thoroughly exhausting training session, we're walking together around the academy when…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Stop for a moment if you would, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm. I thought as much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian! How is that assignment coming along?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf abruptly shouts up into the branches of a nearby tree.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Tch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle rustle…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume leaps down from the tree!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How did you know I was there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I heard a faint noise from above as we approached.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There's only one person in Tracen Academy who would try to hide from me in such an audacious manner.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Nothing gets past you, huh? That's half the reason I was hiding.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. Come on, don't be so prickly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer, allow me to introduce you to Narita Brian, the other student council member I mentioned earlier. I suspect you might have heard of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (I certainly have. Narita Brian is a racing powerhouse on par with Air Groove.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If that's all, then I'll be going.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not so fast. You still haven't answered my question. Have you finished the equipment inspection?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll get to it. Speaking of which…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Dunno what it is, but that general manager kid's got something on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The general manager? I see. I'll speak to her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: See you 'round.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She might seem haughty at first, but she's much more caring than she lets on. There are many jobs that only she can do.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, the general manager… Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite the opposite, actually. She only joined the student council recently.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Apparently, I inspired her so much that she wanted to join me in making a difference at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She's been struggling to get used to the work, so the rest of us have been looking out for her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But her enthusiasm is quite enough on its own. And having somebody on the council who looks up to me pushes me to be better, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My biggest accomplishment of the day ends up being learning about Symboli Rudolf's relation with the other members of the student council.
